jei.chiseled_enchanting_table.info.deple:
A used-up enchanted book. Stacks to 64.
Where it comes from: merging books, clearing enchantments, dropping a level I book, or a master tome running out of charges. Also found in chests and in wild chiseled bookshelves.
What to do with it: turn it back into a plain book at the table, or store it in a chiseled bookshelf — it still counts toward your shelf total.
Librarians: 2 scrolls buy 1 Emerald or 2 Amethyst Shards, and they repair plain books from Novice level.
Rewriting one into an enchanted book costs more (and needs a higher-level librarian) the rarer, more universal and higher-level the enchantment is — but always less than a vanilla Mending trade.

More total nearby bookshelves, more Tome enchants, higher relative tier, and universal enchants (Infinity, Mending) take longer — capped at 5 min each. Queue cap: 256 steps / 32,000 characters.
[Sacrifice XP Skip]: Directly spends whole XP levels based on remaining time (capped at 15 levels) to finish safely with 0% Tome damage.

3) Rush Skip: Finishes immediately for 0 extra XP, but risks turning a shelf Template Book into a Depleted Tome (up to %s%% for normal books, %s%% for Infinity books; more shelves & less time left lower the risk).

Sacrifice XP Skip works anytime (even with 0 Tomes); Force Rush requires a nearby Master Tome and always spares Infinity Tomes while any non-Infinity Tome exists!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: How 'Was XX Levels' & Gates Work
Hovering an option shows 'Bookshelf Discount: -X% (Was Y Levels)' — here is what that really means:
[How 'Was Y Levels' is set]: Just like a vanilla Lv.30 table, base gate scales from ~12 up to 30 for max tier (or higher for rare treasures); upgrading existing tiers credits 85% of old progress!
[Use in Green-Orb Mode]: Your entry ticket, NOT full cost! At -40%, 'Was 30' becomes Lv.18 to click — you only spend 1–3 levels and keep XP bar %! This also stops low-level free-XP loops.
[Use in Purple-Flask Mode]: Without a Master Tome, the discounted level is actually paid in full — which is why storing a Tome saves tons of XP!
Quick Takeaway
No Tome = pay the full discounted levels (Purple). Stored Tome = just meet the discounted gate and spend 1–3 levels (Green)!

gui.chiseled_enchanting_table.grimoire.c: Pages & Locks
Page Unlocks, Tomes & Locks
Unlock Cleanse and Tomes, then protect charging tomes
The Cleanse and Tomes tabs start locked. Hover a locked tab, then use this chapter to unlock both pages permanently for your player:
[Cleanse] Put Depleted Tomes on nearby Chiseled Bookshelves and press the amber sacrifice button by the tabs. Sacrificing %s total unlocks Cleanse and grants an advancement.
[Tomes] Put Enchanted Books in at least %s nearby Chiseled Bookshelves (same scan as tome charging). The page unlocks and grants “How Much Longer...”.
[Dashboard] The Tomes page lists every template book in range: remaining charges, generation, time to +1 and time to full, plus the shelf count still needed for the next recharge tier.

[Locks] Select a book and lock it until +1, until full, or permanently. Locked books keep charging but cannot be removed or used anywhere. Early unlock costs %s XP level(s) + %s Cleansing Grit; timed locks release themselves.
Lock All & Reminders
Use Lock All Full for every charging book. Timed locks sparkle on the shelf and ping their owner when they expire.
